description: AngularJS directive wrapping jQuery UI Sortable plugin, enabling sortable lists with AngularJS integration.

methods.name: combineCallbacks
methods.description: Combines two callback functions into one, executing both in sequence.

methods.name: getSortableWidgetInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the sortable widget instance from a jQuery element, supporting older jQuery UI versions.

methods.name: hasSortingHelper
methods.description: Determines if the sortable helper is a clone or a custom helper.

methods.name: isFloating
methods.description: Checks if an item is floating based on CSS float or display properties.

methods.name: getElementScope
methods.description: Finds the Angular scope associated with a DOM element within a list of element scopes.

methods.name: afterStop
methods.description: Callback to destroy the sortable instance after sorting stops.
